answer_1.quote: Experiments show that our method exceeds baselines on five datasets, including open-domain QA, code generation, semantic parsing, and story generation tasks.
answer_1.outputs: Generated outputs such as answers for QA, Bash commands for code generation, semantic parses, and story endings.

answer_2.quote: Metrics. Following , we use those metrics: (1) Exact Match (EM) for GeoQuery, MTOP, and WebQs to assess the accuracy of the generated output. (2) BLEU-1 for Roc Ending to evaluate alignment in story generation. (3) BLEU-4 for NL2Bash to capture longer sequence structure in command generation.
